sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "articles"."authref" AS e, AVG("articles"."accscore") AS m1, AVG(("articles"."contrscore" - "articles"."qualscore")) AS m2, (AVG("articles"."accscore") - AVG(("articles"."contrscore" - "articles"."qualscore"))) AS m3 FROM "articles" GROUP BY "articles"."authref") SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1"
why: average of accessibility score per users (by authref)
controversy score - quality score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same article
average of controversy score minus quality score per users (by authref)
average of accessibility score minus average of controversy score minus quality score: both in points, of the same kind, from different quantities
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sessions"."devrel" AS e, AVG("sessions"."recutil") AS m1, AVG(("sessions"."engscore" - "sessions"."relscore")) AS m2, (AVG("sessions"."recutil") - AVG(("sessions"."engscore" - "sessions"."relscore"))) AS m3 FROM "sessions" GROUP BY "sessions"."devrel") SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1"
quantities: sessions.session engagement score minus content relevance score
why: average of recommendation utility per devices (by devrel)
session engagement score - content relevance score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same user session
average of session engagement score minus content relevance score per devices (by devrel)
average of recommendation utility minus average of session engagement score minus content relevance score: both in points, of the same kind, from different quantities
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sessions"."devrel" AS e, "devices"."conntype" AS g, AVG("sessions"."engscore") AS m1, AVG(("sessions"."recutil" - "sessions"."relscore")) AS m2 FROM "sessions" JOIN "devices" ON "devices"."devkey" = "sessions"."devrel"  GROUP BY "sessions"."devrel", "devices"."conntype") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, (AVG("s1"."m1") - AVG("s1"."m2")) AS m3 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"
quantities: sessions.recommendation utility minus content relevance score
why: average of session engagement score per devices within devices.conntype
recommendation utility - content relevance score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same user session
average of recommendation utility minus content relevance score per devices within devices.conntype
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
average of average of session engagement score minus average of average of recommendation utility minus content relevance score: both in points, of the same kind, from different quantities

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "users"."substatus" AS g, AVG("sessions"."engscore") AS m1, AVG(("sessions"."recutil" - "sessions"."relscore")) AS m2, (CAST(AVG(("sessions"."recutil" - "sessions"."relscore")) AS REAL) / AVG("sessions"."engscore")) AS m3 FROM "sessions" JOIN "users" ON "users"."userkey" = "sessions"."userel" GROUP BY "users"."substatus") SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1"

why: average of session engagement score per users.substatus
recommendation utility - content relevance score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same user session
average of recommendation utility minus content relevance score per users.substatus
average of recommendation utility minus content relevance score relative to average of session engagement score: both in points, of the same kind, from different quantities
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "articles"."authref" AS e, "users"."seglabel" AS g, AVG("articles"."qualscore") AS m1, AVG(("articles"."freshscore" - "articles"."sentscore")) AS m2, (AVG("articles"."qualscore") - AVG(("articles"."freshscore" - "articles"."sentscore"))) AS m3 FROM "articles" JOIN "users" ON "users"."userkey" = "articles"."authref"  GROUP BY "articles"."authref", "users"."seglabel") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"
